summary: KAN-92 adds profile image upload UI, client-side validation, persistence via ProfileService/UserService, and unit tests in profile-form.component.spec.ts. The provided branch diff (origin/main...main) is empty because the feature was already merged (PR #45, commits 9e902d0/c2e1ec9). Two blockers prevent shipping: Header and Sidebar templates bind to non-existent User.avatarUrl instead of User.avatar, so uploaded images never appear outside the Profile page; and removing an avatar clears the preview but does not persist because updateUser keeps the existing avatar when input.avatar is undefined.

gaps: AC 'Profile image is shown in the Header, Sidebar, and Profile page' fails for Header/Sidebar: templates use profileUser()?.avatarUrl but User defines avatar (user.model.ts:14).

AC 'User can update or remove the existing profile image' — remove does not persist: profile-form sends avatar: undefined on save (profile-form.component.ts:423) and user.service updateUser retains existing.avatar (user.service.ts:218).
Provided git diff origin/main...main is empty; review based on merged commits 9e902d0 and c2e1ec9 on main.

profile.component.html:29-30 displays user.avatar on Profile page.
profile.service.ts:63,90 passes input.avatar to userService create/update.

gaps: Property mismatch avatarUrl vs avatar guarantees Header/Sidebar avatar img branch never renders (TypeScript User has no avatarUrl).
Avatar removal sends undefined; merge logic avatar: input.avatar ?? existing.avatar prevents clearing stored avatar.

findings.title: Header and Sidebar bind avatarUrl instead of avatar
findings.detail: User model exposes avatar?: string but header.component.html:72-73 and sidebar.component.html:10-11 check profileUser()?.avatarUrl. Uploaded images persist on User.avatar and display on Profile page only.

findings.title: Remove avatar does not persist on save
findings.detail: removeImage() clears previewUrl; onSubmit passes avatar: this.previewUrl() || undefined. updateUser merge uses input.avatar ?? existing.avatar, so removed avatars reappear after save/refresh.

findings.title: Avatar upload UI lacks component styles
findings.detail: Template uses profile-avatar-section, avatar-container, btn-secondary, sr-only but inline styles omit rules; may affect mobile/desktop layout polish.

findings.title: Layout avatar image CSS missing
findings.detail: Templates reference class avatar-img and sidebar-avatar but no matching rules in header.component.css or sidebar.component.css.

checklist: Fix header.component.html and sidebar.component.html to use profileUser()?.avatar (match user.model.ts).
Support explicit avatar removal: pass null/empty sentinel or use 'avatar' in input merge like address/bio fields in user.service.ts updateUser.
Add CSS for .avatar-img, .sidebar-avatar, and profile-form avatar section.
Add header/sidebar spec assertions that img renders when user.avatar is set.
Re-run npm test on Node >=22 after fixes.
